from pathlib import Path

def get_file_size_kb(path):
    """Get file size in KB."""
    return path.stat().st_size / 1024

def calculate_capacity(size_kb, limit_kb=8.0):
    """Calculate capacity percentage."""
    return (size_kb / limit_kb) * 100

# Check memory files
print("=" * 80)
print("Memory File Health Status")
print("=" * 80)
print()

# Global Memory
print("GLOBAL MEMORY (~/.claude/memory/):")
global_path = Path.home() / ".claude/memory"
global_files = {
    'session-history.md': global_path / 'session-history.md',
    'common-errors.md': global_path / 'common-errors.md',
    'lessons-learned.md': global_path / 'lessons-learned.md'
}

global_total = 0
for name, path in global_files.items():
    if path.exists():
        size_kb = get_file_size_kb(path)
        capacity = calculate_capacity(size_kb)
        global_total += size_kb
        status = "OPTIMAL" if capacity < 85 else "WARNING" if capacity < 95 else "CRITICAL"
        print(f"  {name:25s} {size_kb:6.2f} KB ({capacity:5.1f}%) [{status}]")

global_capacity = calculate_capacity(global_total, limit_kb=24.0)
global_status = "OPTIMAL" if global_capacity < 85 else "WARNING" if global_capacity < 95 else "CRITICAL"
print(f"  {'TOTAL':25s} {global_total:6.2f} KB ({global_capacity:5.1f}%) [{global_status}]")
print()

# Project Memory
print("PROJECT MEMORY (./.claude/memory/project/):")
project_path = Path('.claude/memory/project')
project_files = {
    'current-session.md': project_path / 'current-session.md',
    'project-errors.md': project_path / 'project-errors.md',
    'project-lessons.md': project_path / 'project-lessons.md'
}

project_total = 0
for name, path in project_files.items():
    if path.exists():
        size_kb = get_file_size_kb(path)
        capacity = calculate_capacity(size_kb)
        project_total += size_kb
        status = "OPTIMAL" if capacity < 85 else "WARNING" if capacity < 95 else "CRITICAL"
        print(f"  {name:25s} {size_kb:6.2f} KB ({capacity:5.1f}%) [{status}]")

project_capacity = calculate_capacity(project_total, limit_kb=24.0)
project_status = "OPTIMAL" if project_capacity < 85 else "WARNING" if project_capacity < 95 else "CRITICAL"
print(f"  {'TOTAL':25s} {project_total:6.2f} KB ({project_capacity:5.1f}%) [{project_status}]")
print()

# Combined
combined_total = global_total + project_total
combined_capacity = calculate_capacity(combined_total, limit_kb=48.0)
combined_status = "OPTIMAL" if combined_capacity < 85 else "WARNING" if combined_capacity < 95 else "CRITICAL"
print(f"COMBINED MEMORY:")
print(f"  {'TOTAL':25s} {combined_total:6.2f} KB ({combined_capacity:5.1f}%) [{combined_status}]")
print()
print("=" * 80)

EOF
